description: This file implements a Twitch username resolver adapter that uses the Twitch Helix API to resolve usernames or user IDs to user IDs, including functions for normalizing usernames, creating loggers, and resolving targets via API calls.

methods.name: normalizeUsername
methods.description: Normalizes a Twitch username by removing '@' prefix and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: createLogger
methods.description: Creates a logger that wraps an optional existing logger, adding Twitch-specific prefixing.

methods.name: resolveTwitchTargets
methods.description: Resolves an array of Twitch usernames or IDs to user IDs using the Twitch Helix API, with credential validation and error handling.
